title: Product
description: One product in the mock catalog. Lives in products/<id>.json; images live in images/<id>/. Every human-readable string is localized (en + pt-BR) and every price is given in BRL and USD.

photo.description: One shot of the product, on both backgrounds.

#ffffff.description: Source PNG on a pure white background, named <slug>-white.png. The slug names the shot. catalog.json serves the WebP generated from it.

#f5f5f5.description: Source PNG of the same photo on #f5f5f5, named <slug>-gray.png. Produced by npm run backgrounds. catalog.json serves the WebP generated from it.

id.description: kebab-case slug in English. Must match the file name and the images folder.

brand.description: Optional. Omit it when the product has no brand. When present, it is fictional: never a trademark or a real brand name.

name.description: Long, marketplace-style listing name (product, size, material, color, key features; a brand only when the product has one). At least 60 characters per locale.

description.description: Two or three sentences. At least 80 characters per locale.

price.description: Current selling price in each currency.

listPrice.description: Pre-discount price. Only set it when the product is on sale; each currency must be greater than the matching price.

defaultVariantId.description: The variant a product card shows before the shopper picks anything.

options.description: The axes a shopper chooses: color, size, volume, capacity, pack count, or anything else the product needs. A product can have several.

hex.description: Swatch color. Required when the option id is color.

variants.description: One entry per combination you sell. Price, stock and photos live here.

options.description: option id to value id, e.g. { "color": "sage", "size": "queen" }
